items.text: This is a small quality of life with a bunch of improvements to little details throughout the game!
Updated unity version to 2022.3.62f2 - This update fixes a security vulnerability found in the unity runtime (CVE-2025-59489)
You can sit on the train seats now!
Added a "Motion Sickness Reduction" setting that disables the bobbing on a held Camera / Photo while walking, which may help users that experience motion sickness while playing.
Added a "Highlight photos" setting which will add a shine effect to photos the player has not picked up to make them more obvious (defaults off)
Added mouth animations to Cait while talking!
Added support for Traditional Chinese
Navigating back with a controller while a settings menu dropdown is open will now close the dropdown instead of the settings menu
Adjusted timing & trigger conditions for a few voice lines
Improved situations where some chairs would be sat on in uncomfortable ways
Improved "Photo Sensitivity" mode
Improved rewind icons
Improved the "broken" detection for teleporters
Improved rotating carried objects
Improved display of text in some cases where it could be awkwardly wrapped / displayed
Improved the transition when restarting a level
Improved trigger conditions for the "Nope Bridge" achievement
Improved how photos mid-transition in the final level are shown
Made Chapter 3 Level 4.2 cloudier
Updated credits
Improved performance when taking & placing photos
Greatly improved taking & placing photo performance on the final level
Improved performance of transitions
Improved performance when carried objects are colliding with certain objects
Improved performance of various shaders
Improved audio performance
Optimized how assets are loaded to lower RAM usage

topNew: You can sit on the train seats now!
Added mouth animations to Cait while talking!

items.text: We’ve just released version 1.0.6 of Viewfinder, in which we’ve fixed various bugs and issues as well as added a few small changes to make your experience better.
Lowered minimum field of view from 90 to 70.
Added a count the collectibles popup, i.e. 2/4 when you've found two ducks.
Added a ‘delete save slot’ button in the save slot menu.
Fixed an instance where additional film could become uncopyable after rewinding if a photo was placed overtop of the already picked up film.
Fixed an instance where the camera unusable if you rewinded too quickly after acquiring the camera unless the level was restarted.
Fixed being able to take the train into levels with if you returned to the menu while riding the train.
Fixed an issue where the player could get stuck falling through the floor in the final level.
Fixed an audio clip from the ending of the game persisting when starting a new save.
Fixed a few instances where subtitles were attributed to the wrong speaker.
Fixed minor errors in the English & Arabic subtitle lines.
Fixed an issue that allowed <16:10 aspect ratios (i.e. 4:3) to function incorrectly.
Fixed an issue that allow the incorrect slot data & nonfunctioning back button to be shown on <16:10 aspect ratios.
Fixed an issue that could cause progress to be lost when creating a new save slot.
Improved the control mapper layout at ultrawide aspect ratios.
Removed non-functional duplicate crosshair setting.
Removed non-functional "run" option from the control remapping.
Fixed one of Jessie's lines for falling in the pit still being able to play after you've found the photo.
Fixed an edge case that could cause the "Hitching a ride" achievement to trigger when the player wasn't actually hitching a ride.
Fixed a collider issue in Chapter 3, Level 5.4 to stop the player sitting on a stool with an audio log player on it.
Fixed an issue in Hub 3 where a the train was clipping through a pillar & rotated a stool so sitting on it doesn't make you stare at a wall.
Fixed a collider issue in Chapter 4, Level 9.1 to fix an unintended solution.
Fixed a bug where you could exit a level to the last hub world you were in from a previous save slot.
Fixed the battery in Chapter 3, Level 6.3 disappearing or moving after placing a photo over it and then rewinding.
Fixed losing the ability to interact with rewind if it is pressed twice after standing up from a chair.
Fixed a case where you could be unable to discard changes when the prompt “Do you want to keep these changes?” appears.
The Sad Owl Studio team!
